newsitem.title: UK: Police arrest two over 1994 attack on Heathrow.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest two over 1994 attack on Heathrow.

text.p: British police said on Monday they had arrested two people in connection with an Irish Republican Army (IRA) mortar bomb attack on Heathrow airport in 1994.
They said the two men were arrested on Monday at separate addresses in west London. They gave no other details.
Heathrow airport was hit in March 1994 by five mortars fired inside the airfield perimiter from a lorry which had been driven close to the boundary fence.
There were no injuries but the attack halted airport traffic and international flights.

The attack coincided with a parliamentary debate to renew the Prevention of Terrorism Act, which allows police special powers to combat Irish guerrillas seeking the end of British rule in Northern Ireland.
